source: blind 6-second H3 car-ad MP4; the extraction/generation process was not given its original prompt or condition package
input_to_h3: the MP4 plus one fixed non-semantic instruction: use <Video 1> as the sole visual reference
generation_result: The generated ad retains a red sports car, coastal-road cinematography and a male driver, but it does not reconstruct the source frame-by-frame.

independent_package_replay.result: exact replay of the reference-conditioned generation

inversion_verdict: This is behavior-equivalent reference conditioning, not unique inversion of the original text condition, initial noise or final latent. H3 exposes no arbitrary-video-to-original-condition inverse.
operational_limit: A reference package cannot be replayed with the ordinary FL2VA model; it must carry model-mode metadata. The first attempted mode-mismatched replay exhausted NPU memory, and the corrected Ref2VA replay succeeded after worker restart.
